paragraphs.text: Cards from Shadows over Innistrad compared to cards from earlier sets .
Aim High is strictly better than Savage Surge .
Avacynian Missionaries is strictly better than Shu Elite Infantry , and Trokin High Guard .
Breakneck Rider is strictly better than Balduvian Barbarians and Hurloon Minotaur .
Burn from Within is strictly better than Blaze .
Bygone Bishop is strictly better than Chapel Geist , Keen-Eyed Archers , Pearled Unicorn , Shadow Glider , Sunspire Griffin , and Wild Griffin .
Convicted Killer is strictly better than Goblin Hero , Gray Ogre , and Raging Bull .
Daring Sleuth is strictly better than Coral Eel , Coral Merfolk , Jhessian Lookout , Wetland Sambar , and Wu Infantry .
Deathcap Cultivator is strictly better than Leaf Gilder .
Descend upon the Sinful is strictly better than Final Judgment .
Duskwatch Recruiter is strictly better than Balduvian Bears , Barbary Apes , Bear Cub , Cylian Elf , Forest Bear , Grizzly Bears , and Runeclaw Bears .

Gatstaf Arsonists is strictly better than Berserkers of Blood Ridge , Bonebreaker Giant , Fire Elemental , Fomori Nomad , Frost Ogre , and Obsidian Giant .

Inner Struggle is strictly better than Wrack with Madness
Inquisitor's Ox is strictly better than Foot Soldiers , Great Hart and Pillarfield Ox .
Inspiring Captain is strictly better than Ampryn Tactician .
Invasive Surgery is strictly better than Envelop .

Thraben Gargoyle is strictly better than Razorgrass Screen .
Tooth Collector is strictly better than Eyeblight Assassin .
Topplegeist is strictly better than Aven Skirmisher , Kitesail Scout , Lantern Kami , and Suntail Hawk .

The reveal lands are strictly better than taplands : Port Town is strictly better than Coastal Tower and Meandering River . Choked Estuary is strictly better than Salt Marsh and Submerged Boneyard . Foreboding Ruins is strictly better than Urborg Volcano and Cinder Barrens . Game Trail is strictly better than Shivan Oasis and Timber Gorge . Fortified Village is strictly better than Elfhame Palace and Tranquil Expanse .

The enemy color taplands are strictly worse than the allied trilands, the wedge trilands, the gates, and the lifegain taplands: Forsaken Sanctuary is strictly worse than Arcane Sanctum , Nomad Outpost , Sandsteppe Citadel , and Scoured Barrens . Foul Orchard is strictly worse than Jungle Hollow , Opulent Palace , Sandsteppe Citadel , and Savage Lands . Highland Lake is strictly worse than Crumbling Necropolis , Frontier Bivouac , Mystic Monastery , and Swiftwater Cliffs . Stone Quarry is strictly worse than Jungle Shrine , Mystic Monastery , Nomad Outpost , and Wind-Scarred Crag . Woodland Stream is strictly worse than Frontier Bivouac , Opulent Palace , Seaside Citadel , and Thornwood Falls .
Equestrian Skill is strictly worse than Vow of Wildness .
Might Beyond Reason is strictly worse than Hunting Triad .

Seagraf Skaab is strictly worse than Aquamoeba , Augur of Bolas , Blinding Drone , Chief Engineer , Elusive Spellfist , Erdwal Illuminator , Fathom Seer , Frilled Oculus , Omenspeaker , Renowned Weaponsmith , Research Assistant , and Seacoast Drake .
Silent Observer is strictly worse than Coastline Chimera .
